steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ew... What's that thing? It's sickening...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Looks like something is moving at the bottom...

options: The inheritance is in that altar.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Doesn't it look suspicious? It's put right there for all to see. It's as if whoever put it there desperately wants people to know it has the inheritance in it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There might be some security measures put on it, like a mechanism or a trap.

options: Or maybe it has to be stored that way.

steps.content: Looking down from this distance, you can't see every detail of the altar. But vaguely, you see some strange patterns engraved on it, like something used in a rite.
R is nowhere to be seen.
Zoya is still on the other side of the crypt. She might have come across some hurdle, as you feel she is making slow progress. Despite that, she keeps getting closer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Got it. Those Corruptors might be activated again. Chief, stay behind me...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Watch out!
Out of nowhere, a gigantic ax cuts through the air from behind, coming at you spinning. Nightmare rushes forwards but is able to deflect its trajectory only slightly.
The ax flies overhead and lands heavily on the ground, sinking into the dirt and blocking your way ahead.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who is this?! ...Uh!

Before Hella can turn her head around, a dark shade comes hurtling towards her and deals a blow that sends her flying a few meters. Inertia carries the dark shade along, who then stops in front of the ax.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Such power... It's a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's Master of Axes!
The dark shade rises slowly, picks up the heavy ax with one hand and hauls it over her shoulder. She turns around to face you, oozing murderous malice.
One person holding out against an army... An apt expression for my situation... Cough cough... Good for me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Master of Axes?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...How come the Master of Axes is so tiny? How old is she?
Face your opponent! I'm <color=#fb9259>Horo</color>, a Legion warrior. I'm here to send you to meet your maker.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The inheritance belongs to the Legion. Keep this in mind, and die!
